narration: Socho ek pipe mein paani beh raha hai. Agar pipe ko narrow kar do (matlab resistance badhao), toh paani ka flow (matlab current) KAM hoga, zyada nahi! Isi tarah, I = V/R mein, jab R badhta hai toh I GHATTA hai.

citations.excerpt: It is obvious from Eq. (12.5) that the current through a resistor is inversely proportional to its resistance.
